rows.Col10: Update Notes:

Davis was placed on the initial SEC availability report as out ahead of the Week 4 matchup against Florida. The linebacker has remained sidelined from live game competition while managing an undisclosed physical setback.
Hartrup was added to the SEC availability report as out leading into the Week 6 contest. The receiver remains unavailable for game action pending full clearance from team medical personnel.

Joseph underwent tightrope surgery in mid-October after suffering a significant left ankle injury in the third quarter against Vanderbilt. The defensive back was officially ruled out for the November 7 game and continues his surgical rehabilitation.
Johnson was designated as out on the October 14 league report and did not dress for competition. He remains sidelined from active rotation duties as he continues through his recovery protocol.
McCoy was listed as out on the mid-October availability update and has been unavailable for defensive reps. The safety remains ruled out from selection until cleared to return to practice.

Lacy dislocated his surgically repaired left shoulder in late October against Texas and missed his second straight contest on November 7. Head coach Pete Golding noted the lead back's recovery is a gradual process with no immediate timetable for his return.

Lacy was officially ruled out on the November 4 SEC report and did not suit up for the November 7 matchup. The defensive back remains day-to-day as staff evaluate his practice availability for the coming week.

Curne landed on the Wednesday availability report as out and was held out of the November 7 game. The offensive lineman continues to undergo evaluation with his status monitored ahead of next week's preparation.
